sources.entry: ScreenFlow - Screencasting and video editing software.

summary.name: ScreenFlow
summary.one_liner: ScreenFlow is a screen recording and video editing application from Telestream for creating software demos, tutorials, training videos, and presentations.
use_cases: creating software or app demo videos
making product demos and sales presentations
creating animated GIFs from screen recordings
adding subtitles and captions to videos
summary.what_it_does: ScreenFlow records the screen, camera, and microphone simultaneously and can record an iPhone or iPad screen for app demos. It provides multi-track editing with transitions, text and video animations, titles, filters, freehand annotations, and multi-channel audio. Its caption editor adds and edits ADA-compliant soft subtitles, which can be burned in. Users can export animated GIFs and APNGs, use preset export settings, and access a built-in stock media library of images, video, and music.
notable: Records screen, camera, and microphone in sync, plus iPhone/iPad screen recording
Caption editor for ADA-compliant soft subtitles with burn-in option
Built-in stock media library of images, video, and audio
Styles and templates for editing series of tutorials
caveats: Free trial is fully functional with no time limit, but exported movies are watermarked
Stock Media Library access costs $99/year; bundle and upgrade pricing also offered
Page names no platforms explicitly beyond the Mac context from the listing; Windows support is not stated
